delete.body: After deleting "{{name}}", expiry dates synced through it stop updating — those domains stay in the list, but their data goes stale and expiry reminders stop working with it. The domain records themselves are not deleted.

dialog.desc: Once configured, domain expiry dates are refreshed by the DNS sync scheduled task.

dryRunBadgeHint: Dry-run is ON: write requests (renewal, DNS write-back) are logged only — never sent to the registrar, never charged. Expiry sync is unaffected (it reads the registrar and writes our own DB). Turning it off makes renewals charge for real, irreversibly.

empty.reason: Expiry dates have to be synced from a registrar. Without one, expiry reminders and auto-renewal do not work at all, while the domain list still looks normal — only "last synced" stays stuck in the past.
empty.title: No registrar connected

error.title: The registrar list could not be loaded

field.cloudflareHint: ⚠️ Cloudflare here is registration-only. Its API Token is configured on the CDN sites page (Token + Account ID) — that is the real integration point.
field.dryRunHint: With this on, renewals and write-backs are only logged — no requests are sent and nothing is charged. Leave it on for the first sync to confirm the data lines up, then turn it off.
field.keyHint: Issued from the registrar console. Prefer a read-only or domain-management-only key.
field.name: Name
field.noSyncSelected: ⚠️ No sync adapter for this provider yet: it will show as Enabled but expiry dates will not update. If you only need a record, choose "Other".
field.providerHint: Decides which API is used to sync. "Other" means record-only with no automatic sync — a deliberate choice, not a fallback.

hint: Where domain expiry dates are synced from. Without one, expiry dates never update, while the domains themselves look perfectly normal in the list.
liveBadgeHint: Dry-run is OFF: renewing here charges real money, irreversibly. Renewal is non-idempotent — a failure does NOT mean you were not charged; re-check the expiry date before retrying. To rehearse, enable "Dry-run" in Edit.
noSyncHint: No sync adapter for this provider yet; domain expiry will not update automatically
supportedHint: Only GoDaddy syncs expiry dates automatically. Namecheap / Aliyun / Cloudflare can be recorded, but their expiry dates will not update on their own.

sync.interrupted: Sync interrupted — the replica running it ({{replica}}) exited. Click sync again
sync.lastFail: Last automatic sync: {{at}} — {{status}}. Expiry dates were NOT updated
sync.neverRanHint: The scheduled task "Domain expiry sync (registrar API)" has no run history — domain expiry dates have never been updated, so expiry reminders cannot work either. Check whether it is enabled under Runtime / Inspection and trigger it once.
sync.staleHint: These domains no longer appear in the registrar API — possibly transferred out, expired, or the account lost access. Ledger rows are kept, but expiry reminders no longer apply to them. Needs manual review.

title: Registrar connections

usage.hint: These counters are per-replica and in-memory: they reset on restart and each replica counts separately (the cross-replica quota is a different layer). So “0 today” does not mean “no sync ran today” — another replica may have done the work. The rate-limited marker is the signal that matters: once the vendor quota is exhausted, syncs slow down or fail while the domain list still looks fine.
